verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's docs show workflow building/iteration via natural language and strong review tooling (simulations, batch comparisons showing how an edit changed outcomes across scenarios), which covers the 'review' part of the story. However, there is no explicit mention of a version history or a rollback/undo mechanism for automations. missing for 10: explicit versioning/change-history feature, explicit rollback/undo capability, evidence of restoring a prior workflow state.
